target.title: docs(durable): propose durable core runtime boundary and validation plan
target.body:
## Context capsule

This is PR1/5 for the durable runtime stack. It is intentionally docs-only: RFC, root-cause summary, durable-core boundary, validation plan, and stack sequencing before any runtime implementation is reviewed.

## Durable core stack overview

Durable core means the shared, opt-in runtime substrate that records run identity, step/event ordering, parent/child links, bounded refs, recovery states, signals/timers, and read-only inspection for long-running OpenClaw agent/session/task/subagent work. It is needed because local incidents and related public PRs show repeated coordinator-silence, stale-running-session, non-durable parent handoff, restart recovery, and bespoke durable-delivery fixes that cannot be solved cleanly by one product surface alone.

The core is intentionally below Task Flow, Workboard, plugins, sessions, and channel UI: those can project from it, but they should not own the persistence boundary. It is not a general-purpose workflow engine and does not persist raw prompts or large private payloads.

The full stack is: PR1 #101828 docs-only RFC/root-cause/canonical boundary; PR2 #102495 durable runtime core with SQLite state, lifecycle primitives, gateway/operator surfaces, QR repair, and tests; PR3 agent/session/subagent restart and upgrade-safety proof; PR4 schema lifecycle/recovery hardening; PR5 opt-in workflow worker loop. Promotion remains sequential: PR3 waits for PR1+PR2 threshold, PR4 waits for PR3, and PR5 waits for PR4.

This PR is PR1/5: it defines the boundary and root-cause plan only. ClawSweeper has already rated it 🦐 gold shrimp; the remaining question is maintainer product-direction/canonical RFC choice.

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw has several durable-ish records, but no shared runtime identity/lifecycle ledger for agent coordination across process, session, channel, and subagent boundaries. That gap shows up as coordinator silence, stale `running` session rows after live work disappears, non-durable parent handoffs, missed fan-in after restart, and bespoke channel/plugin durable-delivery repairs.

Related public work illustrates the same class of issue: #96853 reconciles stale running sessions; #97715 caps native subagent completion retries after permanently non-durable parent handoff; #90300 routes recovered agent-command replies through durable outbound hooks; and the older #97507/#97508 plus superseded #98717/#98718 durable stack explored overlapping boundaries. This PR makes #101828 the narrower canonical RFC/status source before implementation PRs land.

## Scope

- Adds/updates `docs/specs/durable-session-task-runtime-rfc.md`.
- Adds/updates generated `docs/docs_map.md` metadata for the spec route.
- Explains root cause, observed issues, durable core components, non-goals, first review slice, and the 5-PR stack.
- No implementation code, migrations, CLI, gateway methods, worker loop, or tests are included.

## Non-scope

- No runtime behavior changes.
- No Task Flow, Workboard, channel plugin, or product-specific UI ownership decision beyond keeping them as future projections/consumers.
- No default-on retry/resume/cancel/signal policy.

## Base / diff hygiene

- Base comparison: `origin/main...HEAD`.
- Diff is docs-only: `docs/specs/durable-session-task-runtime-rfc.md` and `docs/docs_map.md`.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.

## Proof matrix

| Gate | Command / artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Docs-only diff | `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` | passed; docs/spec plus generated docs map only |
| Docs map | `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check` | passed after regeneration |
| Whitespace/diff check | `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` | passed |
| Private reference scan | `rg -n '/Users/|worktrees|/tmp/|local-e|bo:' docs/specs/durable-session-task-runtime-rfc.md` | passed; no matches |
| Test marker scan | `rg -n 'test\.only|test\.skip|describe\.only|describe\.skip' docs/specs/durable-session-task-runtime-rfc.md` | passed; no matches |
| Runtime/live proof | not applicable | docs-only PR |

## ClawSweeper requirements

- Includes authored `What Problem This Solves`: yes.
- Includes authored `Evidence`: yes.
- Stored data model / migration impact: not applicable for this docs-only PR; proposed components are named for follow-up implementation review.
- Risk labels ClawSweeper should evaluate: architecture/product direction only.
- Current ClawSweeper result: 🦐 gold shrimp; ready for maintainer review, with maintainer canonical-RFC choice remaining.

## Risk / upgrade notes

No runtime or upgrade risk is introduced by this docs-only diff. Merge risk is architectural: accepting this publishes #101828 as the canonical durable-core RFC while older overlapping durable-runtime discussions/PRs should stay superseded or reconciled.

## Evidence

- Docs-only scope verified with `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`.
- `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check` passed after docs map regeneration.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed locally.
- Scanned the RFC for private local paths/session references; none were present.
- Scanned for focused-test skip/only markers; none were present.
- Live runtime proof, migrations, CLI/gateway behavior, and integration checks are intentionally deferred because this PR contains no implementation code.

## Next gate

Maintainer chooses whether #101828 is canonical. Stack promotion continues only after PR2 also reaches the gold_shrimp_schrimp threshold; PR3 remains gated on PR1+PR2.
